div.head: ECf retr 15.3
div.ab: Sed si ad tante solutionem pecunie non sufficiebat, per hundredum colligebatur quod in uilla non poterat.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 641 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page; the words in bold are the Retractator’s changes to ECf, as Liebermann prints them.

div.ab: But if it was not sufficient for the payment of so much money, what could not be collected in the vill was collected through the hundred.
